verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at docs.lium.io (HTTP 200). There is also an llms.txt at lium.io with agent-directed instructions. Every docs page is available as raw markdown via a .md suffix or an Accept: text/markdown header, and there is a docs-search MCP endpoint, a dedicated agents page and a published agent SKILL.md. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Add `.md` to any page URL for raw markdown (e.g. `/providers/quickstart.md`), or send `Accept: text/markdown`.
Use the MCP server at `/mcp` to search and read the docs (`search`, `read_page`)
The user asks what a GPU costs to rent right now or which GPUs are available: read the public prices below, no account.
An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
